title: Screen check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-a4mk2 0.6's screen calls on the Analog Four MKII, on screen and in RAM (magic SCC1). A mode key steps through four modes: off (stock untouched); FONTS (each of stock's 17 fonts drawn by core_text_draw, a key steps the font, with its width, height and descent, the label drawn through the mod's own bitmap); CALLS (a bottom bar with core_stock_overlay, core_level_readout, the key events held, the last replay's return and the progress box: FILTERS' events held and handed to stock through core_stock_key a second later, a key opens a progress box that fills and closes, NO closes it at once); COVER (CALLS over a checkerboard that keeps the track level readout's field while it runs).
